Write the whole-module specification

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module origen_131206 #(
    parameter S = 4,
    parameter DIFF_TERM = "TRUE"
) (
    input wire clkin_p,
    input wire clkin_n,
    output wire ioclkap,
    output wire ioclkan,
    output wire serdesstrobea,
    output wire ioclkbp,
    output wire ioclkbn,
    output wire serdesstrobeb,
    output wire gclk
);

    wire clkin_buf;

    // Differential input buffer
    IBUFDS #(
        .DIFF_TERM(DIFF_TERM)
    ) ibufds_inst (
        .I(clkin_p),
        .IB(clkin_n),
        .O(clkin_buf)
    );

    // BUFIO2 instance 1
    wire bufio2_1_divclk;
    BUFIO2 #(
        .DIVIDE(S),
        .DIVIDE_BYPASS("FALSE"),
        .I_INVERT("FALSE"),
        .USE_DOUBLER("TRUE")
    ) bufio2_1 (
        .I(clkin_buf),
        .IOCLK(ioclkap),
        .DIVCLK(bufio2_1_divclk),
        .SERDESSTROBE(serdesstrobea)
    );

    // BUFIO2 instance 2
    BUFIO2 #(
        .DIVIDE(1),
        .DIVIDE_BYPASS("TRUE"),
        .I_INVERT("FALSE"),
        .USE_DOUBLER("FALSE")
    ) bufio2_2 (
        .I(clkin_buf),
        .IOCLK(ioclkan),
        .DIVCLK(),
        .SERDESSTROBE()
    );

    // BUFIO2 instance 3
    BUFIO2 #(
        .DIVIDE(S),
        .DIVIDE_BYPASS("FALSE"),
        .I_INVERT("FALSE"),
        .USE_DOUBLER("TRUE")
    ) bufio2_3 (
        .I(clkin_buf),
        .IOCLK(ioclkbp),
        .DIVCLK(),
        .SERDESSTROBE(serdesstrobeb)
    );

    // BUFIO2 instance 4
    BUFIO2 #(
        .DIVIDE(1),
        .DIVIDE_BYPASS("TRUE"),
        .I_INVERT("FALSE"),
        .USE_DOUBLER("FALSE")
    ) bufio2_4 (
        .I(clkin_buf),
        .IOCLK(ioclkbn),
        .DIVCLK(),
        .SERDESSTROBE()
    );

    // Global clock buffer
    BUFG bufg_inst (
        .I(bufio2_1_divclk),
        .O(gclk)
    );

    // Xilinx primitive instantiations
    (* __KEEP = "TRUE" *)
    (* __XIL_PRIMITIVE = "IBUFDS" *)
    wire ibufds_primitive;

    (* __KEEP = "TRUE" *)
    (* __XIL_PRIMITIVE = "BUFIO2" *)
    wire bufio2_primitive;

    (* __KEEP = "TRUE" *)
    (* __XIL_PRIMITIVE = "BUFG" *)
    wire bufg_primitive;

endmodule
